# PrimusDB

[![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/Rust-1.70+-orange)](https://www.rust-lang.org/)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPLv3-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.3.1--alpha-blue.svg)]()

PrimusDB is a hybrid database engine written in Rust combining columnar, vector, document, and relational storage — with AI/ML, graph, full-text search, CDC, and blockchain-audited consensus.

## Current Status

**Alpha release (v1.3.1-alpha).** Core storage engines and CLI are functional. Cluster, backup, federation, and some advanced features are partially implemented. See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for details.

## Quick Start

```bash
# Build from source
git clone https://github.com/devahil/primusdb.git
cd primusdb
cargo build --release

# Generate default config
./target/release/primusdb config init

# Start the server
./target/release/primusdb server start

# In another terminal, verify it works
./target/release/primusdb doctor
./target/release/primusdb version
./target/release/primusdb query "SELECT 1"
```

## Features

- **5 storage engines**: Columnar (analytics), Vector (similarity), Document (JSON), Relational (SQL), Key-Value (CouchDB-compatible)
- **AI/ML**: Predictive analytics, anomaly detection, pattern analysis
- **Graph engine**: Property graph with traversal queries
- **Full-text search**: Inverted index with TF-IDF scoring
- **CDC**: Change Data Capture with WAL-based streaming
- **Blockchain consensus**: Hyperledger-style validation ledger
- **Security**: Argon2 auth, AES-256-GCM, RBAC, API tokens
- **SQL parser**: sqlparser-rs with SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/CREATE/DROP
- **Prometheus metrics**: Tracing with tokio-rs/tracing
- **Unified CLI**: 25+ subcommands with table/json/csv/yaml/plain output
- **TUI**: Interactive terminal shell with auto-discovery

## Installation

| Method | Command |
|--------|---------|
| **Build from source** | `cargo build --release` |
| **Scripted install** | `bash scripts/install.sh` |
| **Docker** | `docker build -t primusdb . && docker run -p 8080:8080 primusdb` |
| **Package** | `bash scripts/package-linux.sh` |

See [docs/getting-started/build-from-source.md](docs/getting-started/build-from-source.md) for detailed instructions.

## Running PrimusDB

```bash
# Generate config
primusdb config init                    # Creates primusdb.toml
primusdb config validate                # Validates config

# Start/stop server
primusdb server start                   # Start with defaults
primusdb server start --port 8081       # Custom port
primusdb server stop                    # Stop server
primusdb server status                  # Show status
primusdb server health                  # Health check

# Diagnostics
primusdb doctor                         # Full system diagnostics
primusdb doctor --aggressive            # Deep diagnostics (disk, metrics)
primusdb doctor --report ./report.txt   # Write report

# Configuration
primusdb config show                    # Display current config
primusdb config init --force            # Regenerate config

# Backup & Restore
primusdb backup create                  # Create a backup (default: ./backups/)
primusdb backup list                    # List available backups
primusdb backup inspect <id>            # Inspect a backup
primusdb backup verify <id>             # Verify backup integrity
primusdb backup delete <id>             # Delete a backup
primusdb restore <backup-file>          # Restore from a backup file

# Administration
primusdb status                         # Server status
primusdb metrics                        # Prometheus metrics
primusdb cluster status                 # Cluster status
primusdb instance list                  # List running instances
primusdb namespace list                 # List namespaces
primusdb engine list                    # List storage engines
primusdb db list                        # List databases
```

## CLI Usage

```bash
primusdb --help
primusdb version
primusdb query "SELECT * FROM users" --format table
primusdb db create mydb --engine document
primusdb db list
primusdb namespace create myapp.prod
primusdb cluster status
primusdb backup create --destination ./backups
primusdb metrics
```

Full reference: [docs/cli/commands.md](docs/cli/commands.md)

## Configuration

PrimusDB uses TOML config files. Generate one with `primusdb config init`:

```toml
[storage]
data_dir = "./data"
max_file_size = 1073741824
compression = "lz4"
cache_size = 104857600

[network]
bind_address = "127.0.0.1"
port = 8080
max_connections = 1000

[security]
encryption_enabled = true
key_rotation_interval = 86400
auth_required = false

[cluster]
enabled = false
node_id = "local_node"
discovery_servers = []
```

See [docs/getting-started/configuration.md](docs/getting-started/configuration.md) for all options.

## API (REST)

```bash
# Health
curl http://localhost:8080/health
curl http://localhost:8080/status
curl http://localhost:8080/metrics

# CRUD
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/v1/crud/columnar/users \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "Alice", "age": 30}'

# Query
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/v1/uql \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query": "SELECT * FROM users"}'
```

Full API reference: [docs/reference/api.md](docs/reference/api.md)

## Drivers

PrimusDB provides native drivers for multiple languages:

| Language | Directory | Status | Documentation |
|----------|-----------|--------|---------------|
| **Rust** | `drivers/rust/` | ✅ Full | [README](drivers/rust/README.md) |
| **Python** | `drivers/python/` | ✅ Full (pure Python) | [README](drivers/python/README.md) |
| **Node.js / TypeScript** | `drivers/node/` | ✅ Full | [README](drivers/node/README.md) |
| **Java / JDBC** | `drivers/java/` | ⚠️ Partial | [README](drivers/java/README.md) |
| **Ruby** | `drivers/ruby/` | ✅ Full | [README](drivers/ruby/README.md) |

All drivers support CRUD operations, query execution, cluster interactions, and connection management.
See [docs/usage/drivers.md](docs/usage/drivers.md) for detailed usage.

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│         Application Layer               │
│  Drivers: Rust · Python · Node · Ruby   │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│            API Layer                    │
│  REST API  ·  CLI (25+ commands)  · TUI │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│         Processing Layer                │
│  AI/ML · Consensus · SQL Parser · CDC   │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│           Storage Layer                 │
│  Columnar · Vector · Document · Rel     │
│  Graph · Full-text · Key-Value          │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│        Infrastructure Layer             │
│  Sled · Encryption · Cache · Cluster    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Roadmap

- **v1.3.x**: CLI improvements, doctor command, config management, packaging scripts
- **v1.4.0**: Full backup/restore implementation, cluster stability, federation
- **v1.5.0**: Driver maturity, benchmark suite, performance optimization
- **v2.0.0**: Production release, GA

## Known Limitations (v1.3.1-alpha)

- Federation is experimental
- TLS not yet configurable via CLI
- Windows not tested
